uploadRefusals.type: This kind of file cannot be uploaded here.
uploadRefusals.heic: HEIC and HEIF photos cannot be uploaded yet. Send the photo as JPEG: on an iPhone choose Settings › Camera › Formats › Most Compatible; on Android turn off the camera's high-efficiency (HEIF) pictures, or share the photo from the gallery as JPEG.
uploadRefusals.empty: This file is empty. Choose it again and retry.
uploadRefusals.size: This file is larger than the {size} you may upload. Send a smaller file or a smaller copy of the picture.
uploadRefusals.sizeUnknown: This file is too large to upload here. Send a smaller file or a smaller copy of the picture.
uploadRefusals.quota: You have used all the space you have for uploads. Remove some of your older attachments, or ask the staff for more space.
uploadRefusals.unreadable: This file could not be read or checked: it may be damaged or not the kind of file it says it is. Open it on your device, save it again as a new file and retry.
uploadRefusals.dimensions: This picture has too many pixels to read. Save it as a standard JPEG, or a smaller copy of it, and retry.
uploadRefusals.animation: This animation cannot be used here, or it has too many frames. Send a still picture or a shorter animation.
uploadRefusals.reaction: Reaction pictures are at most {side} pixels on a side. Send a smaller picture.
uploadRefusals.approval: Your account is waiting for staff to approve it. You can upload files once it is approved.
uploadRefusals.forbidden: You may not upload this file here.
uploadRefusals.rateLimited: Too many uploads in a short time. Wait a moment and retry.
